{{Quote|The Republic wants a diplomatic resolution to this conflict. Every day I work closely with senators committed to peace.''"<br />"''Yes, but peace to benefit whom?|Padmé Amidala and Yutsen|<ref name="agenda" />}}
'''Yutsen''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] for [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Yutsen gave the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] information on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] traffic in return for an interview with [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. During the interview, Yutsen affronted Amidala for being too preoccupied to notice that [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] had been assaulted by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wait, Jar Jar&hellip; How did you get these?''"<br />"''Well, it's a long tello, but&hellip; Mesa gettin dem from Reporter Yutsen from Tri-Neb.|Padmé Amidala and Jar Jar Binks, on the traffic reports that Yutsen gave to Binks|<ref name="agenda" />}}
[[File:PadmeTCW-Agenda.png|thumb|right|100px|Padmé Amidala, whom Yutsen interviewed]]
The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Yutsen was a [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] who worked for [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]].<ref name="agenda" /> In approximately [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] spoke with Yutsen in order to gather information on traffic reports in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in the hopes of finding news relating to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for Binks' friend, [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="agenda" />

Yutsen gave Binks the information on one condition&mdash;that Amidala would agree to an interview with TriNebulon News. During the interview, Yutsen questioned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] commitment to a peace that benefited everybody in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], pointing out that no help had yet been given to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], which had been attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. When Amidala revealed that she didn't know that Rodia had been attacked, Yutsen suggested that she was too preoccupied with her own affairs.<ref name="agenda" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Surely you have heard of the ''terrible'' attacks that have befallen Rodia.''"<br />"''No. That's ''awful'', I had not heard. There has been so much transpiring that&mdash;''"<br />"''Preoccupied, Senator? Perhaps with your ''own'' agenda?|Yutsen and Padmé Amidala, during the interview|<ref name="agenda" />}}
Yutsen, a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Rodian, was a reporter for TriNebulon News, a media group that, according to Amidala, had a reputation for being "vultures." Yutsen manipulated Binks into arranging an interview for TriNebulon with Amidala&mdash;which Amidala did not want to attend. Later, during the interview, Yutsen confronted Amidala about the Republic's commitment to peace and suggested to the senator that she was too distracted by her own agenda.<ref name="agenda" />

==Equipment==
While interviewing Amidala, the Rodian wore a long-sleeved black [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] with a light-blue vest on top.<ref name="agenda" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yutsen appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]'', a six-page [[Star Wars comic books|online comic]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]], which led directly into "[[Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence'']]," the fourth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode004.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
